description: Recommendations in the knowledge base that differ between passages. Cropsy shows the difference to the farmer when the passages involved are retrieved together; it does NOT choose one. 'status' stays 'unresolved' until a qualified reviewer decides, and then the reviewer, date and decision are recorded here. Created 2026-10-16.
